summary: Great Western Trail: Argentina reworks Pfister's cattle-driving engine around the Pampas, adding farmers and new route choices while keeping the deck-building and rondel core intact. It plays very similarly to the original but with fresh route decisions and a slightly different economic rhythm.
praised: fresh take on a proven engine-building formula
new farmer worker type adds decision variety
criticised: very similar bones to the original, so it can feel like more of the same to fans
still a long, dense game with real rules overhead
niche appeal to those who didn't like the original

interaction.detail: As in the original, players share the trail and compete for building spots and delivery timing, while each maintains a private deck and personal board. Direct conflict is limited to positional blocking rather than attacks.

scoring.why: Points come from cattle deliveries, buildings, and objective bonuses much like the original GWT, rewarding an efficient overall engine.
scoring.how_you_win: You build an efficient herd-and-worker engine to deliver valuable cattle repeatedly while grabbing building and objective bonuses, finishing with the highest score.
